font.wordmark: Bricolage Grotesque 800 — the VIPTV wordmark only
font.titles: Title logos (images) instead of typed titles wherever art provides one

focus.tvCard: inner ring: box-shadow inset 0 0 0 4px #FFFFFF, inset 0 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35) — nothing scales
focus.tvButton: focused = solid white fill, others translucent

hero.art: framed 16:9 card, never wider than the source (~774px), never upscaled
hero.ambient: blurred copy behind: filter: blur(60px) saturate(1.3); opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(1.25);
hero.wide: ≥ ~1800px of content: third column (Featured queue on Home, Details on title pages)

breakpoints.desktopNav: collapsed icon rail ≥ 641px, menu button below — never an expanded sidebar

tvFocus.source: Android TV focus system (scale, border, glow, colour) and Compose for TV ButtonDefaults: focused = onSurface container + inverseOnSurface content, focusedScale 1.1
tvFocus.viptv: keep the colour inversion, drop the scale (focusedScale = 1f)
tvFocus.focused: background #F4F2EE; text/icon #111113; shadow 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45); colour transition 150ms
tvFocus.chipSelected: check icon + inset 2px rgba(255,255,255,.6); focused selected = white fill + check
tvFocus.sizes: button 72px tall r12; icon button 72px circle; chip 56px pill; settings row 80px r12
tvFocus.cardFocus: inner ring: inset 0 0 0 3px #FFF, inset 0 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.35); fades in 120ms; nothing scales

tvMotion.heroToContinueWatching: 450ms emphasized: hero lifts 80px + fades; row travels up; top tabs fade 200ms
tvMotion.rowToRow: 350ms standard; focused row title locks to y 512 (cards y 564 on 1920x1080); rows above fade out 200ms
tvMotion.horizontal: focus frame moves across visible cards; row scrolls one card (300ms) when focus reaches the second-to-last visible card
tvMotion.focusRestore: first visit: nearest card on screen; revisit: last focused card (Modifier.focusRestorer())
tvMotion.holdKey: animations retarget from current position; no queue; focus never waits for motion
tvMotion.back: returns to top of Home in one move
